axes_source: Read from data/brands/binance.json: warmth from the hue and chroma of the primary #FCD535 and the canvas #0B0E11; contrast from the ink #181A20 on that canvas, its depth and the chroma of #FCD535; density from its 4px spacing base; geometry from its radii 2, 4, 6, 8, 12px; formality from the chroma of its primary and ink; motion at 0.5 since its motion signature states no duration; type personality at 0.5 since neither face is in the engine's catalog.
